# Code of conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

We welcome constructive, evidence-based conversations about multimodal models, TPU engineering and reproducibility. Please treat contributors respectfully, avoid harassment and keep private information out of public discussions.

Read the full [community code of conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) for expectations and how concerns are handled.
